text_markup: The Runner initiates a run against a server with a rezzed {card:Heinlein Grid} while the Corp has {card:Enhanced Login Protocol} in play. They do not lose any credits to {card:Heinlein Grid}'s ability, as the additional click {card:Enhanced Login Protocol} requires them to spend is spent to initiate the run, and is not spent during the run.
